title: "SI Model Checking"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(performance)
library(see)
library(tidyverse)

# Set targets store path
tar_config_set(store = "../_targets")
```

## SI Biomass Models

```{r}
#| label: model-check-si
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12

tar_load(si_model_check)

si_model_check |>
    pwalk(function(response, predictor, check_plot, ...) {
        cat(paste("###", response, "-", predictor, "\n\n"))
        # performance::check_model objects can be plotted direktly
        print(plot(check_plot))
        cat("\n\n")
    })
```
